about: Battle maps gathered to trace the Verdun battlefield from: trench maps, position maps, situation maps and aerial photographs, French and German, 1916 first. Unlike battle-maps.json these aren't fitted to the ground yet. The scans live in the asset library (.asset-cache/battle-maps), fetched slowly by pnpm map:battle-maps; an archive file of many scanned pages is one entry with `pages`, its image and file named with {page}. Each entry keeps its archive's licence: CC0 and Licence Ouverte maps may be traced freely; others are for reference only.

maps.title: Etain-A, n°201, tirage du 3 août 1918 (40e éd.; 39e éd. 21 mai 1918), 'Secret'
maps.date: 1918-08-03 (French schematic trenches; batteries active since 15 Jun 1918)
maps.shows: both (French red, German blue). Core of the right-bank battlefield: Louvemont, Douaumont, Fleury, Vaux, Damloup, Bezonvaux, Ornes, Eix, Moulainville, Châtillon-sous-les-Côtes, Belrupt. Bbox E5°24'-5°34'30" N49°08'23"-49°19'12"
maps.source: University of Texas Libraries (Perry-Castañeda Library), Field Maps of Colonel Roland T. Fenton / War Mapping exhibit
